title: Not Enough Lib
description: This is a library mod for my mods.
body:
### What is NTL?📖
Not Enough Lib (NTL) is a mod that contains items that are common in mods made by me.

### Why use NTL?🤔
NTL also adds compatibility between my mods, minecraft and other mods.

### Features✨️
This mod adds mainly new ores and alloys to minecraft.

Also feel free to use NTL in your modpacks!

##### If you want to report any issue do it on this youtube channel: [guiviogamer's youtube](https://youtube.com/@guiviogamer)
